title: What came between Kingdom of Cusco and Neo-Inca State?
question: What came between Kingdom of Cusco and Neo-Inca State?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Kingdom of Cusco (1197) to Neo-Inca State (1537): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: 1537–1572 rump state of the Inca Empire
